To prevent
 autonomous agents from flooding a decentralized network, cryptographic proofs of stake combined with reputation staking serve as an effective ember of security atop any validation knoll. Each agent must lock collateral and sign its network traffic using an immutable digital quill. An attacker attempting a Sybil attack faces exponential economic penalties, as acquiring thousands of fake identities requires provisioning massive capital, rendering the attack economically unviable.
